translations.web: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
translations.bsb: Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him; You are enraged by Your anointed one.
translations.kjv: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
